spec.description: Flow-based detection of suspicious network activity from IPFIX data in ClickHouse: SYN/ACK floods, brute-force attempts on remote-access services, port scans and host sweeps, ARP and IP spoofing, and possible data exfiltration. Includes a filterable flow table. Use the source/destination IP (single address or CIDR), port and MAC filters to narrow the view. Thresholds are heuristic and should be tuned to your traffic.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS time,
    if(startsWith(IPv6NumToString(srcip), '::ffff:'), 'IPv4', 'IPv6') AS Version,
    sum(bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM net_monitor.flows 
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(flowstart)
GROUP BY 
    time, 
    Version
ORDER BY time

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    '$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') AS src_any,
    '$target_dstip' IN ('', 'All') AS dst_any,
    multiIf(src_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip',
            position('$target_srcip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_srcip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_srcip', '/32')) AS srcnet,
    multiIf(dst_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_dstip', '/') > 0, '$target_dstip',
            position('$target_dstip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_dstip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_dstip', '/32')) AS dstnet
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time,
    concat(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), ' -> ', replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Connection",
    count() AS "Flow count"
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(flowstart)
  AND protocol = 6
  AND bitAnd(tcpflags, 18) = 16
  AND (src_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), srcnet))
  AND (dst_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', ''), dstnet))
GROUP BY time, srcip, dstip
HAVING "Flow count" > 50
ORDER BY time

spec.title: ACK flood detection

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', '') AS src,
    replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', '') AS dst,
    lower(arrayStringConcat(arrayReverse(extractAll(leftPad(hex(srcMacAddress), 12, '0'), '.{2}')), ':')) AS mac,
    if(position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip', '0.0.0.0/32') AS srcnet,
    if(position('$target_dstip', '/') > 0, '$target_dstip', '0.0.0.0/32') AS dstnet
SELECT
    formatDateTime(flowstart, '%H:%i:%S %d.%m.%Y') AS "Start Time",
    formatDateTime(flowend, '%H:%i:%S %d.%m.%Y') AS "End Time",
    mac AS "MAC Address",
    srcip AS "Source IP",
    dstip AS "Destination IP",
    vlanId AS "VLAN",
    srcport AS "Source Port",
    dstport AS "Destination Port",
    protocol_name AS "Protocol",
    bytes AS "Bytes",
    packets AS "Packets",
    tcpflags_str AS "TCP Flags",
    priority AS "Priority",
    ecn AS "ECN",
    direction AS "Direction"
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(flowstart)
    AND (mac = lower('$target_srcmac') OR '$target_srcmac' IN ('', 'All'))
    AND (
        (
            ('$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') OR (position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0 AND isIPAddressInRange(src, srcnet)) OR src = '$target_srcip')
            AND ('$target_dstip' IN ('', 'All') OR (position('$target_dstip', '/') > 0 AND isIPAddressInRange(dst, dstnet)) OR dst = '$target_dstip')
            AND ('$target_srcport' IN ('', 'All') OR toString(srcport) = '$target_srcport')
            AND ('$target_dstport' IN ('', 'All') OR toString(dstport) = '$target_dstport')
        )
        OR
        (
            '$view_mode' = 'bidirectional'
            AND ('$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') OR (position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0 AND isIPAddressInRange(dst, srcnet)) OR dst = '$target_srcip')
            AND ('$target_dstip' IN ('', 'All') OR (position('$target_dstip', '/') > 0 AND isIPAddressInRange(src, dstnet)) OR src = '$target_dstip')
            AND ('$target_srcport' IN ('', 'All') OR toString(dstport) = '$target_srcport')
            AND ('$target_dstport' IN ('', 'All') OR toString(srcport) = '$target_dstport')
        )
    )
ORDER BY flowstart DESC
LIMIT $limit_records

This panel provides a granular, low-level view of individual IPFIX flow records. It is designed for deep forensic inspection, allowing you to trace a specific security incident down to the physical interface and specific network service involved.
spec.title: Detailed Network Flow Records

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    '$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') AS src_any,
    '$target_dstip' IN ('', 'All') AS dst_any,
    multiIf(src_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip',
            position('$target_srcip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_srcip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_srcip', '/32')) AS srcnet,
    multiIf(dst_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_dstip', '/') > 0, '$target_dstip',
            position('$target_dstip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_dstip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_dstip', '/32')) AS dstnet
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time,
    concat('Port [', toString(dstport), '] ',
           replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), ' -> ',
           replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', '')) AS "Connection",
    count() AS Attempts
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(flowstart)
  AND protocol = 6
  AND dstport IN (22, 23, 445, 3389)
  AND bitAnd(tcpflags, 2) != 0
  AND ('$target_dstport' IN ('', 'All') OR toString(dstport) = '$target_dstport')
  AND (src_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), srcnet))
  AND (dst_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', ''), dstnet))
GROUP BY time, srcip, dstip, dstport
HAVING Attempts > 10
ORDER BY time

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    '$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') AS src_any,
    multiIf(src_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip',
            position('$target_srcip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_srcip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_srcip', '/32')) AS srcnet,
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AS bucket
SELECT
    concat(formatDateTime(bucket, '%H:%i:%S'), ' - ', formatDateTime(bucket + 300, '%H:%i:%S %Y-%m-%d')) AS "Time",
    replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', '') AS "Source IP",
    uniqExact(srcMacAddress) AS "Conflict Level",
    arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> toString(v), arraySort(groupUniqArray(vlanId))), ', ') AS "VLAN IDs",
    arrayStringConcat(
        arrayMap(m -> lower(arrayStringConcat(arrayReverse(extractAll(leftPad(hex(m), 12, '0'), '.{2}')), ':')),
                 groupUniqArray(srcMacAddress)),
        ', ') AS "Detected MACs"
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(flowstart)
  AND direction IN ('Internal', 'Outbound')
  AND srcMacAddress != 0
  AND srcip NOT IN (toIPv6('::'), toIPv6('::ffff:0.0.0.0'))
  AND (src_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), srcnet))
GROUP BY bucket, srcip
HAVING "Conflict Level" > 1
ORDER BY "Conflict Level" DESC, bucket DESC
LIMIT least(toInt64($limit_records), 50)

This panel performs real-time detection of ARP Spoofing and IP Address Conflicts within the local network segments in 5 minutes blocks. By analyzing the Internal and Outbound traffic directions, the system identifies instances where a single logical IP address is claimed by multiple physical MAC addresses.
spec.title: L2 Attack: Local ARP Spoofing Detection

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    '$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') AS src_any,
    multiIf(src_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip',
            position('$target_srcip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_srcip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_srcip', '/32')) AS srcnet
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS time,
    replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', '') AS "Source IP",
    sum(bytes) AS TotalBytes
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(flowstart)
  AND direction = 'Outbound'
  AND dstport IN (20, 21, 25, 53, 80, 443)
  AND (src_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), srcnet))
GROUP BY time, srcip
HAVING TotalBytes > 52428800
ORDER BY time, TotalBytes DESC

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    '$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') AS src_any,
    '$target_dstip' IN ('', 'All') AS dst_any,
    multiIf(src_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip',
            position('$target_srcip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_srcip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_srcip', '/32')) AS srcnet,
    multiIf(dst_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_dstip', '/') > 0, '$target_dstip',
            position('$target_dstip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_dstip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_dstip', '/32')) AS dstnet
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS time,
    replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', '') AS Source_IP,
    replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', '') AS Target_IP,
    uniq(dstport) AS "Unique ports"
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(flowstart)
  AND protocol IN (6, 17)
  AND NOT (srcport < 1024 AND dstport >= 1024)
  AND (src_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), srcnet))
  AND (dst_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(dstip), '::ffff:', ''), dstnet))
GROUP BY time, srcip, dstip
HAVING "Unique ports" > 200
ORDER BY time

Each bar in the graph represents a unique Source IP performing anomalous scanning behavior on single target IP address, attempting to discover vulnerable services on host machines within the monitored network segments.
spec.title: Reconnaissance: Vertical Port Scan

spec.rawSql:
WITH
    '$target_srcip' IN ('', 'All') AS src_any,
    multiIf(src_any, '0.0.0.0/32',
            position('$target_srcip', '/') > 0, '$target_srcip',
            position('$target_srcip', ':') > 0, concat('$target_srcip', '/128'),
            concat('$target_srcip', '/32')) AS srcnet
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(flowstart, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS time,
    replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', '') AS Source_IP,
    uniq(dstip) AS "Unique targets"
FROM net_monitor.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(flowstart)
  AND NOT (protocol IN (6, 17) AND srcport < 1024 AND dstport >= 1024)
  AND (src_any OR isIPAddressInRange(replaceAll(toString(srcip), '::ffff:', ''), srcnet))
GROUP BY time, srcip
HAVING "Unique targets" > 100
ORDER BY time, "Unique targets" DESC

spec.description: This toggle switches the analysis mode of the forensic table. Original (normal) displays flows strictly matching the defined source and destination criteria. Bidirectional automatically mirrors the search parameters to retrieve both the initial request and the corresponding response, providing a complete view of the network conversation.
spec.label: Flow Direction
spec.name: view_mode

spec.description: This variable supports filtering by specific hosts or entire subnets. You can enter an individual IP address (e.g., 192.168.0.15) to isolate a single device, or a network range using CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.0.0/24) to monitor an entire segment. Leaving the field empty or selecting "All" disables the filter.
spec.label: Search source IP address
spec.name: target_srcip

spec.description: This variable supports filtering by specific target hosts or subnets. You can enter an individual IP address (e.g., 192.168.0.15) to isolate a single receiver, or a network range using CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.0.0/24) to monitor an entire destination segment. Leaving the field empty or selecting "All" disables the filter.
spec.label: Search destination IP address
spec.name: target_dstip

spec.description: This variable filters flows based on the physical hardware address of the sender. Enter the MAC address in standard colon-separated format (e.g., 00:1A:2B:3C:4D:5E) to trace network activity back to a specific physical device within the local network segments.
spec.label: Search source MAC address
spec.name: target_srcmac

spec.description: These variables filter traffic based on specific network service ports. You can enter a port number (e.g., 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS, or 22 for SSH) to isolate traffic associated with a particular service. Set to "All" or leave empty to view activity across all ports.
spec.label: Search for source Port
spec.name: target_srcport

spec.description: These variables filter traffic based on specific network service ports. You can enter a port number (e.g., 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS, or 22 for SSH) to isolate traffic associated with a particular service. Set to "All" or leave empty to view activity across all ports.
spec.label: Search for destination Port
spec.name: target_dstport

spec.description: This variable defines the maximum number of flow records displayed in the forensic table (e.g., 20, 100, or 1000). Adjusting this value helps balance the level of detail with dashboard performance and query execution speed.
spec.label: Limit Number
spec.name: limit_records
